run_CfvExp_selfplay_training: run the CFVExp selfplay training loop with a config to train a CFR value network
build_model_with_build_model: build a CFR value model from config with optional JIT compilation and half precision
create_mdp_config_from_yaml: create a RecursiveSolvingParams MDP config from a YAML-style dictionary for CFR solving
clip_gradient_norms: clip gradient norms of model parameters to a max norm value during training
get_last_action_index_from_query: get the last action index from a query tensor using one-hot action encoding
